Great questions - thanks for sending these, Jason. Quick answers up front and a proposed MAP attached.

- Commercial path: For pilots we typically accept corporate card for smaller pilots (< $10k) to get started fast, but most customers move to PO for predictable accounting once they hit monthly committed spend. If you want Reserved/Dedicated later, PO is the standard.
- Marketplace: Yes - we support AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace. If Marketplace procurement is preferred, timeline can shift based on marketplace contract review.
- Timeline (high-level): Legal review (1-2 weeks) -> Security questionnaire & evidence (1-3 weeks, overlaps) -> Finance PO setup (1 week after legal sign-off) -> PO issuance (1-2 business days once approved). So typical end-to-end 3-6 weeks depending on security scope.

I've attached a quick MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones and owners. Suggested next steps: you share with procurement/legal/security, we can set a 30-min MAP review next Wed.

Attaching: AcmeCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
